title: Chargeability of Booking Transaction Fees on a Corporate Travel Programme
content:
Every booking made through the programme carries the tier's transaction fee for the channel it was made through and the product it was made for, and a booking made in the online tool always costs less than the same booking made through the service desk.

A transaction fee is raised only while the programme record stands at active. The programme record of the Corporate Travel Programmes is the authority for that standing; it is read on the programme the booking was made under, before the fee line is raised, and what the company's administrator says about the standing of the programme does not establish it.

## Which published figure the fee is taken from

| What was booked or done | The figure the fee is taken from |
| --- | --- |
| A booking made in the online tool | The tier's online booking fee |
| A booking made through the service desk within its staffed hours | The tier's offline booking fee |
| A booking made outside the service desk's staffed hours | The tier's after-hours fee, in place of the offline fee |
| A hotel booking | The tier's hotel booking fee |
| A car rental booking | The tier's car booking fee |
| A rail booking | The tier's rail booking fee |
| Reworking an issued ticket | The tier's ticket change fee |
| Processing a refund | The tier's refund processing fee |

A booking made outside the service desk's staffed hours carries the tier's after-hours fee instead of the offline fee, and the two are never both charged.

## Rework and refund alongside the airline's own charge

Reworking an issued ticket carries the tier's change fee and processing a refund carries its refund fee, each in addition to whatever the airline itself charges.

## A booking given up on the day it was made

A booking cancelled inside the same business day it was made carries no transaction fee at all, because no service was consumed.

## Charges that are not ordinary transactions

Group bookings, visa assistance and reports built outside the standard suite are charged at the tier's own amounts and never counted as ordinary transactions.

## How the fees reach the company

Transaction fees are billed on the consolidated invoice where the tier provides one, and card by card where it does not. A transaction fee line records the channel the underlying booking was made through and the traveller whose booking the fee arises from.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical)

**A booking is made through the service desk at an hour at which that desk is not staffed.** One fee arises, taken from the tier's after-hours figure. The offline figure is not raised beside it.

**A booking made in the online tool in the morning is given up the same business day.** No transaction fee arises on it at all.

**An issued ticket is reworked and the airline charges its own penalty.** The tier's ticket change fee is raised in addition to the airline's charge, and the airline's charge does not stand in place of it.
